findings.title: A passed player is not reconsidered after enemy Overrun brings a target within5
findings.expected: After a non-consecutive pass and an opponent combat, return to the waiting eligible player; a now-near target permits that unit to select Overrun.
findings.actual: Three real native activations and a legal witnessed enemy Overrun bring the nearest enemy from beyond5 to about4.326. The waiting unit is alive and unselected. The engine retains owner in passed_player_ids and ends Fight step, offering Consolidation.
findings.qualification: Constructed initial Fight-step eligibility inventory after an initially engaged scene; all movements and attacks after checkpoint use native public decisions. Tail expecting the waiting unit attacks remains enabled but is not executed beyond this failed assertion.

findings.title: Blocked objective fallback cannot complete because reachability is unresolved
findings.expected: A moved model unable to reach the selected objective in3 inches may finish closer while its rules unit ends coherent, unengaged and in range.
findings.actual: The real objective per-model reachability query returns UNRESOLVED for the native attached member behind a solid8-inch-high sealed wall; the otherwise legal0.1-inch closer proposal is rejected consolidation_reachability_unresolved. The unobstructed and legal-decline siblings distinguish the if-able branch and legal continuation.
findings.geometric_reason: Lord radius40mm/2: leader starts(10,12.5), objective(16,10). Marker40mm with3-inch control. Wall x11.10..11.20,y9..30,z0..8. A whole base must cross to objective side, pass south below8.213, north above30.787 or above wall8. Each is beyond3 inches from the initial pose. Proposed leader(10.1,12.5) is closer, remains on its side; body(12.1,10) remains in objective range and group distance is sqrt(2^2+2.5^2)<2+40mm.
findings.qualification: Constructed already-permitted native attachment, objective and terrain checkpoint after an engaged start. No claim that an unresolved result proves unreachable; the geometric proof above is independent. No general solver performance bound or solver repair.
findings.not_duplicate: No prior register owns this objective fallback computational gap.
